_doc: Catálogo de assets para producción con Recraft (ver docs/pipeline_recraft.md). El troceador (slice_assets.mjs) lee de aquí targetH/face/largestOnly por id. Los prompts van en inglés: Recraft los sigue mejor (validado en la prueba de la cera andante).
plantilla_sprite: Video game {CLASE} sprite in the painting style of Final Fantasy IX concept art: {SUJETO}. Three-quarter top-down JRPG view. CRITICAL STYLE: dark romanticist OIL PAINTING with dramatic chiaroscuro — rich impasto brushwork, deep violet-indigo shadow tones, glowing amber and aged-brass highlights, melancholic gothic clockwork atmosphere, golden-hour rim light from upper left. The background must be a plain very dark muted violet, almost black. NOT cute, NOT pastel, NOT watercolor, NOT children's book illustration, NOT white background. Single subject centered, clear readable silhouette, no text, no watermark.
plantilla_textura: Seamless tileable {TIPO} texture for a video game, top-down view: {SUJETO}. CRITICAL STYLE: dark romanticist oil painting, muted warm palette of amber, honey and aged brass over deep violet-indigo, painterly but with even lighting and NO vignette so the tile repeats invisibly. The image must tile seamlessly on all edges. No text, no watermark, no single focal object.
plantilla_hoja: Icon sheet for a video game: a {REJILLA} grid of same-size icons, generously spaced, each icon centered in its cell, on a plain very dark muted violet background. CRITICAL STYLE: miniature romanticist oil paintings with a subtle luminous rim, deep violet shadows, glowing amber/brass accents, Final Fantasy IX fantasy charm. Icons in reading order: {LISTA}. No text, no watermark.
flujo: remove_background de Recraft SIEMPRE (los umbrales locales fallan con sujeto oscuro)
